target.title: fix(gateway): guard JSON.parse malformed input in parseJsonStringArray
target.body:
fix(gateway): guard JSON.parse malformed input in parseJsonStringArray

## Description

`JSON.parse(trimmed)` throws an unhandled SyntaxError when the input is malformed JSON (e.g. truncated string, invalid syntax). This crashes the caller with a bare SyntaxError instead of a clear validation error.

## Fix

Wrapped `JSON.parse` in try/catch to throw the same descriptive `Error` used for non-array or non-string element validation, so all malformed inputs produce the same message regardless of parse stage.
